thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT P1 - billing.tally anomaly detected. Realtime token counts diverging from billable aggregates by ~12% starting 03:10 UTC. Pager to oncall.
kevin: oncall here, investigating. pulling consumer metrics.
maria: seeing overage emails triggered for a few customers, flagged by support. pinging support.
billing-eng: consumer lag on kafka topic `usage-emitter` partition 12 ~250k, recent deploy shows OOMs in emitter pod logs: ```k8s logs billing-emitter-7f4 OOMKilled``` suspect rolling deploy caused memory regression.
sre-ops: mitigation proposal: scale emitter to 5 replicas, revert last deploy (v2.4.0 -> v2.3.1), and temporarily suspend overage alerts. execute in that order.
kevin: scaling now: `kubectl scale deploy/billing-emitter --replicas=5 -n prod` -> scaled. `kubectl rollout undo deploy/billing-emitter --to-revision=123` started.
kevin: consumer lag dropping to ~80k after scale, CPU/mem stabilizing on new pods.
support-lead: affected customers: AcmeCorp (enterprise), BrightApps (mid). We've got 4 overage notifications in last 20m. Request: pause auto emails for 1h and create SLA notice draft.
billing-eng: turning off overage-email flag: `PATCH /config feature.overage_alerts=false` -> applied. will queue manual notices after we reconcile counts.
maria: what's our plan for correcting counts? do we need a backfill or reconcile pass?
billing-eng: plan: run backfill that replays emitted usage from Kafka offsets 0..12 for window 03:00-04:00 into billable pipeline. rough command: ```bq query --use_legacy_sql=false 'INSERT INTO billing.raw_usage SELECT * FROM streaming_stage WHERE event_time BETWEEN "2026-03-17T03:00:00Z" AND "2026-03-17T04:00:00Z"'``` will run as a job and monitor for duplicates.
kevin: started backfill job and opened ticket INC-12345 for tracking. monitoring job progress: 12% done.
incident-bot: Update: status page updated to "Investigating". Pager note added. Incident owner: kevin. Postmortem-assignee: maria.
eva: I'll take second-shift handoff in ~25m. oncall-ack, will watch consumer lag to zero and confirm backfill completes. :+1:
kevin: handing off to @eva in 25m. leaving runbook notes and current offsets in INC-12345.
support-lead: support will hold off billing escalations until we confirm reconciled counts. drafting customer note.
eva: ack. I'll post a final update when backfill finishes or if we need to roll additional mitigation. tagging billing-eng for duplicate suppression checks.
kevin: thanks all, marking major mitigations done. keep thread for updates.
